# ADR-3236: AWS secrets: Shared secret across environments for service 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Prod/non-prod secret sharing collapses blast radius.

## Decision

Services SHALL NOT reuse a shared secret across environments for service 4 (AWS-secrets-4) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Each environment has unique secrets.
